name: Slow Cooker Shredded Taco Pork
ingredients: 4 pounds pork roast (also called pork butt, pork shoulder, or pork shoulder roast)
1/4 cup grass-fed butter, ghee, or butter flavored coconut oil
unmapped: homemade taco seasoning spices (chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, oregano) - no single board home; pantry-spice blend, negligible per-serving cost
why: Verified published macros clear the band: 411 cal / 33g protein / 1.6g carbs per serving. Pork shoulder/butt slow-cooked and shredded, structurally low-carb (meat + butter + spice, zero rice/beans/potato). Scales cleanly to 14 servings by weigh-and-divide. Sits near the calorie floor (411) so our label-DB recompute could drift under 400 - medium confidence on clearing our own gate, high confidence it is in-lane and low-carb. Not a duplicate: catalog pork-shoulder dishes are all rice bowls; no plain low-carb taco pork base exists.
